references.text: Moses placed the wave offerings in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them as a wave offering before the Lord, as part of the priestly consecration ritual.
The continuation of the wave offering ritual at the ordination of the priests, where the offerings were taken from their hands.
Instructions that whoever brings a thank offering shall carry the fat and the breast to wave it as a wave offering before the Lord.
The subsequent action in which Moses took the wave offerings from their hands and burned them on the altar.
Aaron waved the breast and the right thigh as a wave offering before the Lord, just as Moses had commanded.
The priest was to take the boiled shoulder and place it in the hands of the Nazirite and wave it as a wave offering before the Lord.
God's command to anoint Aaron's sons just as their father was anointed, so that they might serve as priests.
